journey.heading: Your journey
journey.intro: Eight steps, from your result to ongoing care. Each step has one person who is responsible for it.

states.CONFIRMED: Your blood pressure is checked again
states.REFERRED: You are referred to a specialist clinic
states.CLOSED: Your case is closed by a clinician

journey.whoTitle: Who is responsible for the next step
journey.closedNote: Only a clinician can close a case, and only after reviewing the evidence.

next.title: What happens next
next.youOwnerNote: This step needs you. {{owner}} is accountable for it.

notify_patient.title: Your care team tells you your result
notify_patient.text: You will get a message in your language with the reading and what to do.

patient_acknowledge.title: Tell us you understood your result
patient_acknowledge.text: Answer the warning sign questions and one short question about your result.

choose_confirmation_method.title: Choose how to check your blood pressure again
choose_confirmation_method.text: You can measure at home for a week, or wear a monitor for 24 hours.

complete_home_readings.title: Take your readings at home
complete_home_readings.text: Measure twice a day and add each reading here.

attend_abpm.title: Attend your 24 hour monitor appointment
attend_abpm.text: The clinic will give you a monitor to wear for a day and a night.

clinician_review_confirmation.title: A clinician reviews your readings
clinician_review_confirmation.text: You have given enough readings. A clinician now looks at them.

clinician_closure_decision.title: A clinician decides the next step
clinician_closure_decision.text: Your readings did not confirm a raised pressure. A clinician will decide what happens next.

send_referral.title: Your clinician sends your referral
send_referral.text: Your clinician prepares a referral to a clinic that can look after you.

reassign_or_rerefer.title: Your care team finds another clinic
reassign_or_rerefer.text: The first clinic could not take your referral. This is not about you. The team is arranging another.

accept_referral.title: The clinic accepts your referral
accept_referral.text: The clinic reads your referral and confirms it can see you.

book_appointment.title: Choose a time for your visit
book_appointment.text: The clinic accepted your referral. Pick a time that suits you.

record_visit_outcome.title: Attend your visit
record_visit_outcome.text: After the visit, the clinician records what was agreed.

four_week_review.title: Your four week review
four_week_review.text: Your clinician reviews how things are going. Your weekly action runs until then.

consider_closure.title: A clinician considers closing your case
consider_closure.text: Your recent readings look settled. A clinician decides whether to close the case.

default.title: Your care team is working on the next step
default.text: Nothing is needed from you right now.

result.heading: Your result

source.IFHAS_SCREENING: Screening result from a simulated source (IFHAS)

result.mmHgNote: Top number over bottom number, in mmHg.
result.needsChecking: This is a raised reading that needs checking. It is not a diagnosis.
means: Your blood pressure was higher than expected at one time.
One reading can change from day to day, so it needs to be checked again.
Checking again shows whether it stays raised.
notMeans: It does not mean you have a lifelong illness.
It is not a final result.
It is not a reason to panic.
result.urgencyRaised: This is not an emergency. It is best to take the next step by {{date}}.
result.urgencySevere: This reading is high enough that a clinician will look at it today. If you have any warning sign, get emergency help now.
result.emergencyTitle: If you have a warning sign
result.alreadyUnderstood: You have already told us you understood this result.

understand.heading: Check your understanding
understand.intro: Two short parts. Neither is a test of you. They help us explain things clearly.
understand.flagsIntro: Do you have any of these right now?

flags.vision_change: A sudden change in your vision
flags.one_sided_weakness: Weakness on one side of the body

understand.emergencyFallback: Go to the nearest emergency department now.
understand.emergencyAfter: When you continue, your care team is told, so a clinician can look at your case the same day.
understand.emergencyRecorded: Your care team has been told and a clinician will look at your case the same day.
understand.tbLegend: Choose the answer you think fits best
understand.tbMissing: The question is not available right now.
understand.confidenceLegend: How sure do you feel about what to do next?
understand.retryTitle: Thank you for trying. Here is a simpler way to say it.
understand.retryHint: You can choose again whenever you are ready.
understand.doneText: You have understood your result. Next, we check your blood pressure again.
understand.alreadyDone: You have already answered these questions.
understand.notYet: Your result has not been sent to you yet.

confirm.heading: Check your blood pressure again
confirm.needUnderstand: Please finish the questions about your result first.
confirm.chooseTitle: How would you like to check?
confirm.hbpmHelp: You measure twice a day with a validated upper arm cuff and add each reading here.
confirm.abpmHelp: The clinic gives you a monitor to wear for a day and a night.
confirm.abpmBody: The clinic will arrange your monitor appointment. There is nothing to enter here.
how: Sit quietly for five minutes with your back supported and your arm resting at heart height.
Measure in the morning and in the evening, twice each time, one minute apart.
Add every reading below, even if it looks different from the last one.
confirm.errSystolic: Enter a top number between 60 and 260.
confirm.errDiastolic: Enter a bottom number between 30 and 160.
confirm.errOrder: The top number must be higher than the bottom number.
confirm.errPulse: Pulse must be between 30 and 220, or leave it empty.
confirm.errWhen: Enter the date and time of the reading.
confirm.listEmpty: No readings yet. Add your first one above.
confirm.needed: The care team needs at least {{days}} days with two readings each. The first day is not counted in the average.
confirm.averageNone: The average appears after you add readings.
confirm.enough: You have given enough readings. A clinician will review them next.
confirm.reviewed: A clinician has reviewed your readings and confirmed that your blood pressure stays raised.
confirm.notConfirmed: Your readings did not confirm a raised pressure. A clinician will decide what happens next.
confirm.demoText: Instead of typing 28 readings, load the sample week. These are made-up values.
confirm.demoButton: Fill a sample week of readings

status.rejected: The first clinic could not take your referral. This is not about you. Your care team is arranging another one.

weekly.heading: This week's action
weekly.intro: One small step each week. If a week does not go to plan, the next one gets smaller. Nothing is lost.
weekly.notYet: Weekly actions start after your first visit, once treatment or follow-up is agreed.

barrier.NOT_SURE_HOW: Not sure how to do it

weekly.largerOffer: You have done this two weeks running. If you would like, you can choose a slightly bigger step for next week when you check in. It is your choice.
weekly.largerAccept: Yes, try a slightly bigger step next week

feedback.PLAN_SMALLER: That is fine. Some weeks are like this. Next week's step is smaller, so it is easier to fit in.
feedback.PLAN_LARGER_OFFERED: Thank you. Your next action is ready. If you like, you can choose a slightly bigger step later. It is your choice.
feedback.PLAN_NEXT: Thank you for checking in. Your next action is ready.

weekly.noBlameLapsed: Last week did not go to plan. That is fine. This week's step is smaller.
weekly.historyEmpty: Your earlier weeks will appear here.

messages.intro: Messages from your care team, in the language you chose.
messages.aiReworded: Reworded with AI help and approved by {{name}}

privacy.heading: My data
privacy.consentIntro: You decide how your information is used. You can change a choice at any time.

care_coordination.name: Care coordination
care_coordination.text: Lets your care team follow your case and remind you of each step.
care_coordination.withdraw: Automated messages from your care team stop, and a clinician is asked to decide what happens next. Nothing closes automatically. You can turn this back on here at any time and messages start again.

messaging_channel.name: Messages
messaging_channel.text: Lets your care team send you messages {{channel}}.
messaging_channel.withdraw: You will not get messages {{channel}}. Your care team will be asked to reach you another way you agreed to. You can turn it back on here at any time.

share_with_receiving_provider.name: Share with the clinic that receives your referral
share_with_receiving_provider.text: Lets your clinician send your readings and referral to the clinic that will see you.
share_with_receiving_provider.withdraw: Your clinician cannot send a referral until you turn this back on. Your care team will explain the options.

lifestyle_programme.name: Weekly actions
lifestyle_programme.text: Lets us suggest one small step each week.
lifestyle_programme.withdraw: Your weekly steps are paused. There are no new weekly actions or reminders, and nothing is recorded as missed. Turn it back on to restart.

research_aggregate.name: Anonymous summaries
research_aggregate.text: Counts you in summary figures that cannot be traced to you.
research_aggregate.withdraw: You will not be counted in aggregate statistics. This does not change your care. You can turn it back on at any time.

data: Everything you see in this prototype is synthetic demo data. The people, readings, clinics and messages are made up.
Your care team can see your case: the readings, the steps and the messages. A clinician sees more detail than a coordinator.
A clinic you are referred to sees your referral only if you allow sharing with it.
Nothing about you is shared with employers or insurers. Programme figures are totals, and any group smaller than 5 people is hidden.
AI is only used to help word messages. A person approves any reworded message. It never decides who is urgent, who is responsible or whether a case closes.
Only a clinician can close your case, and only with evidence or a recorded decision.
Names such as IFHAS, Thiqa and Malaffi appear only as labels of simulated sources.
privacy.changedOffCare: Choice turned off. A clinician will decide the next step with you. You can turn it back on here at any time.

evidence.CARE_TRANSFERRED: Your care moved to another service.
evidence.PATIENT_DECLINED: You chose not to continue with follow-up.
evidence.UNREACHABLE_AFTER_PROTOCOL: We could not reach you after several attempts, so a clinician closed the case for now.
evidence.DECEASED_OR_MOVED: Your case was closed because follow-up moved elsewhere.
evidence.OTHER_CLINICAL_DECISION: A clinician decided that this follow-up can end.

closed.note: You can ask your care team to look at your case again at any time.
